claim_summary: Exact Littlestone and VC dimensions for translates of every fixed-length cyclic interval; an unbounded static-versus-adaptive shattering gap.
integrity: All proof assumptions, quantifiers, exhaustive-check ranges and executable dependencies are stated in RESULT.md and VERIFICATION.md. No paper external to this package is copied in full.
scientific_limitations: Limited to the full translate class of a single nonempty proper cyclic arc, with deterministic realizable Littlestone and ordinary VC dimension. Literature priority is best-knowledge and may be incomplete; computational checks are finite, while the proof is uniform. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: Exact online shattering of fixed-length cyclic arcs
